CustomField.description: Niche-based expected interview target that accumulates monthly. First month = the niche's monthly target; each completed month since Application Start Date adds one more month's target. Niche monthly targets: AI/ML 12, Full Stack (Java) 8, Python 8, PM 6, Marketing 5, Finance Analyst 4. Other/blank niche or no start date = 0. Replaces the flat, niche-agnostic Expected_No_of_Interviews__c for Target Achieved reporting.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(Application_Start_Date__c) || TEXT(Niche__c) = "Other" || ISBLANK(TEXT(Niche__c)), 0, CASE(TEXT(Niche__c), "AI ML Engineer", 12, "Product/Project Manager", 6, "Java Fullstack Developer/Engineer", 8, "Python Developer/Engineer", 8, "Finance Analyst", 4, "Marketing Manager", 5, 0) * MAX(1, (YEAR(TODAY()) - YEAR(Application_Start_Date__c)) * 12 + (MONTH(TODAY()) - MONTH(Application_Start_Date__c)) - IF(DAY(TODAY()) < DAY(Application_Start_Date__c), 1, 0) + 1) )
CustomField.label: Expected Interviews (Target)
